title: An agent for doctors.
lead: Charting, prior auth, the inbox. Handled, so you can stay with the patient.

customSkills.title: Visit-note drafting
customSkills.desc: Listens with consent. Drafts a SOAP note, pre-fills the codes you usually pick.

customSkills.title: Prior-auth packets
customSkills.desc: Pulls problem list and recent labs. Assembles the packet your payer accepts.

customSkills.title: Inbox triage
customSkills.desc: Reads patient messages and labs. Escalates the two or three that need you today.

automations.title: After-visit summary
automations.desc: Closed encounter produces a patient-friendly summary, routed for your review.

automations.title: Refill orchestration
automations.desc: Refill requests get checked against PDMP and EHR. Draft for your sign-off.

automations.title: Care-gap outreach
automations.desc: Weekly run identifies patients overdue for screening and drafts outreach.

footerBlurb: Runs inside your clinical environment. PHI never leaves the tenant or trains a public model. BAA signed on deployment.
